body:
My girlfriend and I were bored and lately I had been reading about legal highs on the internet. I came to
a website and read through many experience reports on a couple differen't things and when I came to the morning glory vault I had remembered seeing these flower seeds at a store. Got a ride to Wal-Mart and bought 10 packs of Burpee's Heavenly Blue Morning Glory seeds at 99 cents a piece so it added up to about 10 dollars. Went home and washed the seeds with liquid detergent and put the in a paper towel to dry. I ate a good meal because I planned on eating the seeds in about 3 hours. I eat and time goes by, I count out 400 seeds for me and 200 for my girlfriend (I always make her take half of what I take so I know she'll be ok). The time comes, We both ingested our seeds chewing every one to a paste(I read on other reports if you don't you won't trip). It took about 15-20 minutes to eat them, I coulden't eat the last of mine so I ended up eating about 350. Here's a time lay-out for ya'.
8:00 P.M.-Ingested 350 morning glory seeds, chewing them to a paste.
8:20 P.M.-Finish eating morning glory seeds, slight stomach discomfort
8:40 P.M.-Stomach discomfort increases but it's not unbearable
9:00 P.M.-Girlfriend gets sick, still no sign of MG
10:00 P.M.-It's not 2 hours after I've ate the seeds and I'm starting to doubt that I'm going to get any effects which really pisses me off because I ate those nasty seeds and my stomach has been hurting since I ate them.
10:30 P.M.-I can feel that something is differen't, I could tell it wasen't much but I was just happy that I could feel something.
11:00 P.M.-I've been thinking about strange things and my mind seems like I have an overload of ideas in my head.
12:00 P.M.-The same thing just alot of ideas.I kinda came to terms with what MG did so I just sat there and thought for a couple hours, occasionaly focusing on something hoping it will move.
All in all, it's not worth the stomach ache and nasty taste. I've read that Hawiian Baby Rosewood seeds are far more potent and really do work.
